title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for the Japanese Derby. Mihono Bourbon remains calm and collected, despite the chanting crowd calling her name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In a rare display of ambition, Rice Shower declares that she'll catch up to Mihono Bourbon today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon remains unfazed by this and stays focused on attaining victory. And so, the curtain rises on the Japanese Derby…
